statements.status_notes: Marked no-dsa by Debian Security Team; see https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-62377
The vulnerable vvdec_push_data2 function is part of libheif's vvdec decoder backend. Debian does not build the vvdec backend in its binary packages, so the vulnerable code is not present.
